criteria.recurring_status: A regular team check-in where people report progress and blockers
criteria.project_working_session: Hands-on work on one project: demos, reviewing designs, agreeing build details
criteria.proposal_signoff: One person presents a proposal and asks others to approve it
criteria.vendor_or_partner: A conversation with someone from an external company (supplier, partner, reseller)
criteria.company_broadcast: A company-wide meeting where leaders share updates with everyone
criteria.planning_or_strategy: Setting direction, priorities or objectives across several areas
criteria.other: None of the above describes the meeting

criteria: Monologue: one speaker gives almost every line and others barely speak
Presentation: one speaker leads; others mainly ask short questions or agree
Discussion: a few people contribute points and respond to each other, but one or two people drive it
Active collaboration or debate: many people jump in, challenge each other and build on each other's ideas
interaction.instructions: Use the speaker_stats field together with the transcript.

criteria.true: Participants agreed what will happen next, including hedged agreements such as 'probably not this round, we'll look again next cycle' or 'let's book a call in October'
criteria.false: The meeting ended with only information shared and no agreement on what will happen

criteria.true: A plan agreed before this meeting was altered here: a date moved earlier or later, scope cut or pushed to after launch, or something postponed or cancelled
criteria.false: Every plan and date that existed before the meeting still stands unchanged; only new plans were made

criteria.true: By the end it is clear who does each next step, either by name or because someone says 'I'll do X'
criteria.false: Next steps were left vague, with nobody saying who will do them

criteria.true: Nayem Reza took on a new task in this meeting: they were asked to do something, or said 'I'll do X' or 'I'll set that up'
criteria.false: Nayem Reza took on nothing new; any Nayem work mentioned was already agreed before

criteria.true: A main subject of this meeting is a large deliverable, such as a product, site or system, that Nayem Reza builds, owns or launches
criteria.false: The meeting's main subjects are other people's work or an outside company's offering; Nayem Reza's own projects come up only as side context

criteria.true: A task owned by Nayem Reza has a deadline within 7 days, stated as a date, a day or a word such as 'today', 'tomorrow' or 'Monday'
criteria.false: No task owned by Nayem Reza has a deadline within 7 days

criteria.true: Someone is stuck: they cannot do a specific next step until Nayem Reza gives them access, credentials, content, a preview or a decision
criteria.false: People may expect things from Nayem Reza, but nobody is stuck waiting; they can carry on with their own work meanwhile

criteria.true: A problem nobody knew about before this meeting is revealed here, and it could stop a deliverable or make it miss its deadline
criteria.false: Every problem discussed was already known and underway before the meeting, such as a supplier already running late, or is minor or solved in the meeting

criteria.true: An existing known problem was reported as getting worse, overdue, or needing escalation
criteria.false: No existing problem was reported as getting worse or needing escalation

criteria: No deadline is under pressure: deadlines are weeks or months away, or none are discussed
A deadline is days away and people are racing to meet it, but it is described as on track
A deadline is described as likely to slip
A deadline or planned date has already been missed or delayed

criteria.true: Security or compliance work was discussed in substance: pen testing, audits, certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 2), access control or compliance tooling
criteria.false: Security or compliance was not discussed, or only mentioned in passing, e.g. as a type of training or as a reason for something else

criteria.true: Money Voxsmart spends or would spend was discussed: costs, quotes, prices, budgets, contracts, purchase orders, statements of work or software renewals
criteria.false: The only money mentioned is revenue, sales pipeline or percentages of team time

criteria.true: A next step with an external supplier or partner was agreed, such as a call booked, a quote or document requested, or a list to be shared
criteria.false: No next step with an external supplier or partner was agreed
